entries.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one isolated high-resolution 2D side-view game weapon sprite for Alien: Earth (FX series), targeting the documented screen prop. Use the provided official FX photograph strictly as the visual reference for the MCS-X Modular Combat System Mark X; remove the person and environment and render ONLY THE SAME ONE WEAPON in a clean left-to-right side elevation, muzzle pointing right, stock at left. Preserve its olive drab battered angular bullpup housing, short thick compact proportions, large open triangular top carry-handle bridge, black grip/trigger opening, segmented side panels, heavy squared forward casing, two small blue-lit panels near the upper muzzle and small cylindrical underbarrel torch. Match the original prop's identity; no M41A pulse rifle substitution, no long AR barrel, no additional scope, no invented branding. Sharp hand-painted cinematic realistic game art, detailed metal/polymer wear, readable silhouette, moderate neutral lighting. Entire gun visible with 10 percent transparent margin, true transparent background, no floor, no shadow, no person, no hands, no magazine diagram, no words, no frames, no collage. Exactly one asset in the image.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: exactly ONE isolated full-body creature sprite based on the single largest ADULT specimen at the far RIGHT of the supplied Weta Workshop Alien: Earth Species 19 lifecycle concept. Preserve that adult's anatomy accurately: narrow gold-brown pointed armored anterior, dark brown chitin thorax, THREE PAIRS of jointed hooked limbs (SIX limbs total) around the anterior, and the extremely long tapered translucent smoke-brown abdominal sac with darker internal segmented contents. Do not use a round common Earth tick shape and do not add spider eyes or an extra pair of legs. Present this single adult in lateral three-quarter game view, armored head pointing RIGHT and long translucent abdomen trailing LEFT, limbs in low grounded crawling stance. Keep full sac and all limb tips visible, silhouette approx 3 times as long as high. Match reference colors and material contrast, premium detailed hand-painted 2D realistic sprite with neutral soft lighting. Transparent background, zero environment, no ground shadow, no gore, no victims, no eggs or other lifecycle stages, no labels/logos/text, no diagram. Only one specimen.

Use case: stylized-concept. Create exactly one isolated FULL-BODY 2D game character sprite of Hermit / Joe (Alex Lawther) from Alien: Earth. Identity and uniform reference: the young unhelmeted man IN THE CENTER of image 1, not the two helmeted men. Slim young adult male, pale face, short tousled brown hair, clean shaven; worn grey-blue search-and-rescue uniform, short sleeves rolled to elbows, small chest utility pockets, dark belt, grey cargo trousers, practical dark boots. Preserve his recognisable face and slim physique, no helmet or mask. Weapon reference image 2: the exact olive bullpup MCS-X with triangular carry-handle and compact blocky front. Full body three-quarter SIDE VIEW facing RIGHT; relaxed alert stationary ready pose holding that MCS-X at chest/waist level pointing horizontally right, index off trigger, feet grounded on same baseline. Only one man and his one held weapon; weapon is PART of this sprite, no separate floating gun. Premium detailed hand-painted realistic 2D character art, faithful restrained palette, clean silhouette, neutral consistent lighting; head hair feet muzzle all visible with generous transparent margins. True transparent background, no environment, floor, cast shadow, text, labels, logos, sheet, extra poses or companions. Do not include the flashlight cone from reference 1.
